searchText: It's time to restrict posting access in this channel, imho Slow mode could be a good option, so outside followers could still occasionally post a question or comment, without spamming the space with low quality "debate"? Yes, and now that I think it through I realize that's not necessarily the case since they presumably start at different times and different histories.... But for some reason I assumed the consensus indexes onto the execution. But of course the beacon block number is not the same as the mainnet block number now before the merge, so they shouldn't be same after the merge. But I didn't grasp this until I read <@340345049063882753> 's reply. Hello, I have an issue building the `merge-kiln-v2` branch of `go-ethereum` where the script is not able to find go source files off an azure server. I'd appreciate any help. Error message: ``` make geth env GO111MODULE=on go run build/ci.go install ./cmd/geth go: downloading golang.org/x/crypto v0.0.0-20210322153248-0c34fe9e7dc2 go: downloading github.com/cespare/cp v0.1.0 go: downloading github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/storage/azblob v0.3.0 go: extracting github.com/cespare/cp v0.1.0 go: extracting github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/storage/azblob v0.3.0 go: extracting golang.org/x/crypto v0.0.0-20210322153248-0c34fe9e7dc2 go: downloading github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore v0.21.1 go: downloading github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/internal v0.8.3 go: extracting github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore v0.21.1 go: extracting github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/internal v0.8.3 go: finding github.com/cespare/cp v0.1.0 go: finding github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/storage/azblob v0.3.0 build github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore: cannot load github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore: no Go source files make: *** [Makefile:12: geth] Error 1 ``` I've checked github and the link resolves, so idk what's wrong You should be using the `master` branch of geth now 😄 Are you using a specific guide? https://notes.ethereum.org/@launchpad/kiln is relatively updated and should work best https://agstakingco.gitbook.io/kiln-testnet-ethereum-staking-guide/ this was linked from here https://notes.ethereum.org/@launchpad/kiln Geth + teku Yea unfortunately its out of date now, I'll add a warning to it. But if you scroll down on the @launchpad link you'll see commands you need to run, but it isn't as verbose as the other guides. yy, ok understood. I'm new to eth core things. So I'm sorry if I sound confusing. tysm for the help No problem at all, things have changed a decent bit in terms of branches/flags since Kiln and its hard for everyone to update all docs 😅 Thankfully we'll have ropsten soon and a new flurry of guides with updated info should be out just got 2 servers exclusively to help as much as I can with testing the merge makes sense I can help with writing docs how does the process work? aka how do people collaborate on the docs? Last time around we had some "scaffold" docs with the basic info out (Will hope to have that out by Wednesday). Then the community wrote more verbose docs, made videos, etc and tagged us so we added links back to the scaffold docs. I think that approach worked quite well last time around, happy to try some new approach as well. I just want to know what is the most efficient way I can pitch in to help with pushing this forward I'm still getting the same error with the `master` branch: ``` make geth env GO111MODULE=on go run build/ci.go install ./cmd/geth build github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore: cannot load github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore: no Go source files make: *** [Makefile:12: geth] Error 1 ``` I really feel the build script is trying to download something that has shifted places You're probably still on Marius's fork, You need to `git clone https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/` and then `cd go-ethereum && make all`? oh, ok now I get it then the entire docs is wrong for that specific part Which docs? Ah wait the launchpad https://agstakingco.gitbook.io/kiln-testnet-ethereum-staking-guide/ Yeah we need to change that ``` git remote -v origin https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/ (fetch) origin https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/ (push) ``` ``` make all env GO111MODULE=on go run build/ci.go install build github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore: cannot load github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore: no Go source files make: *** [Makefile:17: all] Error 1 ``` I feel it's just the build script tries to download something in all instances. Microsoft must've shifted the location of azcore imo still can't get go-ethereum to build same error? I’ll suggest to take a look at Dockerfile.source here and see how it might differ from what you’re doing manually. This builds reliably: <https://github.com/eth-educators/eth-docker/blob/main/geth/Dockerfile.source> yes I'll try this. I'm doing erigon and nethermind atm Make sure you are using go 1.18 as well. Also try `make geth` instead of `make all` just in case it's one of the other tools that's failing for you.
